analysis: exact finite-state forecast, paired whole-game bootstrap, uniform and ordered action-only weights
audit_estimator: mean raw label probability across requests, renormalized over valid labels
calibration_gate: observed counts CDF sup distance at or below its 99th-percentile finite-sample predictive reference
live_policy: sample a single token and reject tokens outside the exact labels
primary: paired CRPS for final-three-round high-bid share in empty-start communicating games
repeat_gate: median state split-half TV <= 0.03 and max sentinel split-half TV <= 0.12
secondary: three or more high bids in each of the final three rounds
